item.title: Government launches consultation on facial recognition use by police
item.body: The government is launching a consultation to help develop a new legal framework for the use of facial recognition and similar technologies by law enforcement.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🔒 Government launches consultation on facial recognition use by police

The government is launching a consultation to help develop a new legal framework for the use of facial recognition and similar technologies by law enforcement.

Source: GOV.UK Home Office | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 4 November, 10:50
